basic_info.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Microsoft | C, C++ 11/14/17/20/23, Python, Linux, Systems Programming, Realtime, Low Latency, Performance, Optimization, Async, Network Protocols, Streaming, Transcoding, Audio/MIDI
basic_info.about:
I have a robust skill set in Linux systems programming, honed through the creation and maintenance of critical, high performance web services at companies like Microsoft and Akamai, and the design and creation of open source projects focusing on real-time, low latency audio and MIDI.

I believe that writing performant code is an ethical imperative.  Code that is optimized to use less resources uses less energy, resulting in a lower carbon footprint.

At Microsoft, I'm the sole maintainer of a backend audio transformation service that is deployed in Azure data centers worldwide.  The service handles around 200 million requests a day, and is expected to have high performance and low latency.  Multiple services in the Speech Services ecosystem depend on the service for demuxing, audio decoding, audio encoding, muxing, and various audio transformations.

Unfortunately, most of my open source work is out-of-date.  If you want to see current code, check out the progress on my `synthclone` rewrite here:

https://codeberg.org/surfacepatterns/synthclone/src/branch/surfacepatterns/rewrite

I'm currently only interested in opportunities that allow me to relocate to northwestern Europe.  I am particularly interested in opportunities that allow for relocation to Denmark, Norway, the Netherlands, Ireland, or certain parts of the UK, but willing to consider opportunities to relocate to other countries too.  

I'm *not* interested in opportunities that require working in the United States.  If you are a recruiter and ignore this boundary, I will ignore your message and block you.  Thanks in advance for respecting my boundary.

experience.title: Senior System Software Engineer
experience.description: Linux kernel programming; network protocol analysis and optimization with emphasis on TCP/IP

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description: Created a front-end optimization product based on mod_pagespeed; added HTTPS support to mod_pagespeed's fetcher (https://code.google.com/p/modpagespeed/issues/detail?id=423); designed custom mod_pagespeed optimization filters; architected and implemented the product's controller API and front-end web application

experience.title: CTO
experience.description: Designed and developed a Zope-based content management system for nonprofits

projects.name: midisnoop
projects.description: midisnoop is a simple MIDI monitor and prober. You can use it to monitor a MIDI device and/or software, and to send MIDI messages to a MIDI port to see how the device/software responds. midisnoop supports both ALSA and JACK MIDI ports via the RtMidi library.

projects.name: synthclone
projects.description: synthclone is a tool that allows you to create sample-based instruments. You can create sample-based instruments by sending MIDI messages to your MIDI-capable gear or software that instructs an instrument to emit sounds for a series of notes, velocities, controls, and aftertouch values, or by recording your own samples. After the sampling is done, you can apply effects to your samples, and finally save this data as a sample-based instrument that can be loaded by sampler software.
